Required trait hook that records the lowered type associated with a HIR node and span. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Optional trait hook that exposes the inference context when type lowering is running with one. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Trait hook that marks the lowering context as tainted after an emitted error so later analysis can account for the failure. It does not call any other Methods List method.
Default adapter that returns `self` as a trait object so helper code can work with `dyn HirTyLowerer`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Required trait hook that returns the generic arguments to use for a particular definition id, along with whether omitted arguments should be inferred. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Required trait hook that lowers a syntactically provided generic argument into a `ty::GenericArg`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Required trait hook that synthesizes a generic argument when one is omitted, using defaults or inference as appropriate. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers a HIR lifetime into a `ty::Region` by resolving named bound, early-bound, free, static, and error cases from `TyCtxt`; when the lifetime is omitted or unresolved, it calls `tcx` to access resolution data and calls `re_infer` to produce an inferred region.
Lowers the generic arguments attached to a single path segment and rejects any associated-item constraints there. It calls `lower_generic_args_of_path` to do the main lowering work.

Core path-generic-argument lowering routine that validates argument counts, combines parent and self arguments, and lowers explicit or inferred lifetime/type/const arguments for the target definition. It calls `tcx` to fetch generic metadata, and inside its local `GenericArgsLowerer` implementation it delegates per-argument lowering to `lower_lifetime`, `re_infer`, `ty_infer`, and `ct_infer` as needed.

Returns this lowering context’s stored generic arguments only for the exact definition id being lowered, otherwise indicating that no arguments are supplied for other definitions. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers a user-provided generic argument according to the parameter kind, handling invalid-argument recovery and default-parameter stability checks. It calls `tcx` for context access, calls `lower_lifetime` for lifetime arguments, and calls `ct_infer` when an inferred const argument is supplied.

Synthesizes an omitted generic argument by inferring a lifetime/type/const or by instantiating a declared default, while also recovering from earlier argument-count errors. It calls `tcx` for query access, calls `re_infer` for omitted lifetimes, calls `ty_infer` for inferred type parameters, and calls `ct_infer` for inferred const parameters.

Lowers generic arguments for an associated item path using already-lowered parent arguments, then rejects associated-item constraints on that segment. It calls `lower_generic_args_of_path` to perform the lowering.

Lowers a trait reference appearing in an `impl` by first forbidding generic arguments on non-final path segments and then producing a monomorphic trait reference for the final segment. It calls `lower_mono_trait_ref` to construct the resulting `ty::TraitRef`.

Lowers a possibly higher-ranked trait bound into a poly trait ref, pushes the resulting trait bound into the accumulated bounds, and lowers associated-item constraints on the trait segment. It calls `lower_generic_args_of_path` to lower the trait’s generic arguments, calls `tcx` to obtain late-bound variables, calls `item_def_id` when registering the bound, calls `dcx` when checking the expected error state for negative bounds, and calls `lower_assoc_item_constraint` for each associated-item constraint.

Lowers a non-polymorphic trait reference by checking for internal fn-trait issues, lowering the trait segment’s generic arguments, rejecting associated-item constraints, and constructing a `ty::TraitRef`. It calls `lower_generic_args_of_path` to lower the arguments and calls `tcx` to build the final trait reference.
Checks whether a trait defines an associated item with the requested name and kind. It calls `tcx` to access the trait’s associated items.

Lowers a path segment naming a type-like item by first lowering its generic arguments and then either creating a lazy type-alias projection or instantiating the item’s declared type. It calls `tcx` for definition/type queries and calls `lower_generic_args_of_path_segment` to obtain the segment arguments.

Finds the unique trait bound on a type parameter that defines the requested associated type. It calls `tcx` to access HIR/type context data, `probe_ty_param_bounds` to collect the parameter’s bounds, reads the parameter name from HIR, and then calls `probe_single_bound_for_assoc_item` with candidates produced by `traits::transitive_bounds_that_define_assoc_item`.

Filters the provided trait-bound candidates to those whose trait defines the requested associated item by calling `probe_trait_that_defines_assoc_item`. If none match, it reports the failure via `complain_about_assoc_item_not_found`; if multiple match, it builds an ambiguity diagnostic and may lower constraint types/consts with `lower_ty`; otherwise it returns the single matching `PolyTraitRef`.

Lowers a qualified associated path on `qself_ty` by first probing enum variants with `probe_adt` and rejecting unexpected generics with `prohibit_generic_args`, then trying inherent associated types via `probe_inherent_assoc_ty`. If neither applies, it resolves the defining trait bound using `probe_single_bound_for_assoc_item` or `probe_single_ty_param_bound_for_assoc_item`, and returns the lowered associated item type together with its `DefKind` and `DefId`.

Searches inherent impls of an ADT for an inherent associated type with the given name by calling `probe_assoc_item_unchecked`, then selects the applicable impl with `select_inherent_assoc_type_candidates`. After selection it validates accessibility with `check_assoc_item`, lowers any explicit associated-item generics with `lower_generic_args_of_assoc_item`, and returns the resulting alias type and definition id.

Tests each inherent associated type candidate in an inference context by unifying its impl self type with the requested `self_ty` and checking impl obligations. If no candidate applies it reports the error with `complain_about_inherent_assoc_ty_not_found`; if several apply it reports ambiguity with `complain_about_ambiguous_inherent_assoc_ty`; otherwise it returns the unique applicable candidate.

Looks up an associated type by name in the given scope and returns its DefId if found and valid. It calls `probe_assoc_ty_unchecked` to perform the raw lookup, then calls `check_assoc_ty` to enforce accessibility and stability before returning the item.

Performs the raw associated-type lookup in a scope by adjusting the identifier for the current block and scanning associated items for a type-namespace match. It does not call any other Methods List method.

Validates a found associated type by checking its visibility from the current definition scope, emitting and recording an error if it is private, and always performing a stability check afterward. It calls `set_tainted_by_errors` when the privacy error is emitted.

Collects accessible trait names whose associated types could match the requested associated-type name for `qself_ty`. It filters all traits by associated-type presence, visibility, and existence of a non-negative impl whose self type can unify with `qself_ty`, then returns their path strings.

Lowers a fully qualified associated type path. If the self type is missing it calls `error_missing_qpath_self_ty`; otherwise it lowers the trait reference with `lower_mono_trait_ref`, lowers associated-item generic arguments with `lower_generic_args_of_assoc_item`, and constructs the projection type.

Rejects generic arguments and associated-item constraints on path segments. It reports generic-argument misuse with `report_prohibit_generics_error`, and if constraints are present it reports the first one via `prohibit_assoc_item_constraint`.

Classifies which path segments are allowed to carry generic arguments for a resolved path, based on the resolved item kind and optional self type. It inspects constructors, enum variants, parents, generics, and ADTs to return the list of `GenericPathSegment` positions that should accept generics.

Lowers a resolved HIR path into a type by dispatching on `path.res`. Depending on the case it rejects misplaced generics with `prohibit_generic_args`, lowers path arguments with `lower_generic_args_of_path_segment`, classifies generic-bearing segments with `probe_generic_path_segments`, lowers ordinary segments with `lower_path_segment`, lowers qualified associated paths with `lower_qpath`, and lowers type parameters with `lower_ty_param`; it also emits diagnostics and produces error types for invalid path forms.
Lowers a type parameter reference from name resolution into either a late-bound type, an early-bound param, or an error type, based on `tcx.named_bound_var`.
Lowers a const-parameter reference from name resolution into either an early-bound `ParamConst`, a late-bound const, or an error const, based on `tcx.named_bound_var`.

Main recursive HIR-type lowering entry point. It lowers delegation placeholders with `lower_delegation_ty`, references by calling `lower_lifetime` and `lower_ty`, tuples/slices/pointers recursively via `lower_ty`, bare function types by calling `lower_fn_ty`, trait objects by calling `prohibit_or_lint_bare_trait_object_ty` and `lower_trait_object_ty`, paths by calling `lower_path`, and constructs error types for invalid return-type-notation uses.
Lowers a HIR type specifically in path context by directly calling `lower_ty_common` with `borrowed = false` and `in_path = true`.

Validates that a delegated signature does not use unsupported forms and reports diagnostics when requested. It calls `tcx` repeatedly to inspect spans, local HIR nodes, generics, parent item information, definition kinds, and associated item metadata, and calls `dcx`/`emit_err` through the local `try_emit` closure to report delegation errors.
Returns the inherited input or output type for a delegation placeholder by reading the delegation signature from `inherit_sig_for_delegation_item`.

Core HIR-to-`Ty` lowering dispatcher that converts each `hir::TyKind` into the corresponding internal type form. Depending on the variant, it calls `tcx`, `lower_delegation_ty`, `lower_ty`, `lower_lifetime`, `lower_fn_ty`, `prohibit_or_lint_bare_trait_object_ty`, `lower_trait_object_ty`, `lower_path`, `lower_opaque_ty`, and `require_c_abi_if_c_variadic`, while also using `hir` queries and `associated_type_for_impl_trait_in_trait` for opaque/path-related lowering.

Lowers an opaque type reference by building its generic arguments from the opaque item's generics, resolving supplied lifetime arguments with `lower_lifetime`. It returns either a projection type for trait context or an opaque type otherwise.
Lowers a function argument type, but if the HIR uses `_` and an expected type is available it records that type with `record_ty` and reuses it; otherwise it calls `lower_ty`.

Lowers a function type into a `PolyFnSig` by calling `lower_fn_sig`, wrapping the result with late-bound vars, validating CMSE ABI rules, and then checking late-bound lifetime well-formedness with `validate_late_bound_regions`.

When lowering `_` in an impl method signature, tries to recover the corresponding trait method type. It lowers the impl's trait reference with `lower_impl_trait_ref` after lowering the self type with `lower_ty`, finds the matching associated function, and returns either the selected input type or output type from the instantiated trait signature.

Emits errors for late-bound lifetimes referenced in a function return type but not constrained by the inputs. For each such region it constructs a diagnostic with the supplied callback and adds extra notes for anonymous lifetimes before emitting it.

Computes the lifetime bound for a trait object from its existential predicates using `object_region_bounds`. It returns `None` when no derived bound exists, prefers `'static` when present, and otherwise returns the unique derived region while emitting an ambiguity error if multiple distinct bounds are found.
Returns the human-readable string for an associated item kind (`function`, `constant`, or `type`). It does not call any other methods in the provided Methods List.
Registers collect-phase query providers into `Providers` and delegates to `resolve_bound_vars::provide` to install bound-variable related queries before filling this file’s query entries.
Records the span of inferred placeholder types (`_`) encountered in a type node, then calls `intravisit::walk_ty` to continue traversing nested type structure.

Checks generic arguments for inferred placeholders, recording their spans; for inferred args it calls `intravisit::walk_inf`, and for type args it explicitly calls `visit_ty` to reuse type placeholder handling.
Records the span of inferred array lengths and then calls `intravisit::walk_array_len` to visit nested array-length structure.

Emits a placeholder-type diagnostic for item signatures when any placeholder spans were collected; if spans exist, it calls `placeholder_type_error_diag` and then emits the returned diagnostic with `.emit()`.

Builds the detailed diagnostic for illegal placeholder types in item signatures, including generic-parameter replacement suggestions and special handling for bare functions in const/static contexts. It calls `bad_placeholder` to create the base diagnostic and may call `tcx.parent_hir_node` and `multipart_suggestion` when forming suggestions.

Rejects placeholder types in supported item signatures by selecting the item’s generics/suggestion mode, visiting the item with `HirPlaceholderCollector::visit_item`, and then calling `placeholder_type_error` with the collected spans.
Returns the HIR map from `self.tcx.hir()` for nested visitor traversal.

For each item, forces signature-level lowering by calling `lower_item`, checks item signatures for placeholder types via `reject_placeholder_type_signatures_in_item`, and then calls `intravisit::walk_item` to recurse into nested HIR.

Ensures type information for generic parameter defaults is collected: it calls `self.tcx.ensure().type_of` for type defaults and const parameters, calls `self.tcx.ensure().const_param_default` for const defaults, and finally calls `intravisit::walk_generics` to continue traversal.

When encountering a closure expression, forces collection of closure generics and codegen attributes by calling `self.tcx.ensure().generics_of` and `self.tcx.ensure().codegen_fn_attrs`, then calls `intravisit::walk_expr` to visit nested expressions.
Forces lowering of each trait item by calling `lower_trait_item`, then calls `intravisit::walk_trait_item` to traverse inside the trait item.
Forces lowering of each impl item by calling `lower_impl_item`, then calls `intravisit::walk_impl_item` to traverse inside the impl item.
Creates the base diagnostic for placeholder types in item signatures by pluralizing the item kind, sorting spans, and calling `tcx.dcx().create_err` with the placeholder error payload.
Constructs a new `ItemCtxt` with the given type context and item `LocalDefId`, initializing error taint tracking to empty.
Lowers an HIR type in this item context by calling `self.lowerer().lower_ty(hir_ty)`.
Returns the HIR id for the current item by calling `self.tcx.local_def_id_to_hir_id(self.item_def_id)`.
Fetches the current HIR node for this item by calling `self.hir_id()` and then `self.tcx.hir_node(...)`.
Reports whether this item context has already been marked with an error by calling `self.tainted_by_errors.get()` and converting the stored state into `Result`.
Returns the enclosing `TyCtxt` stored in the item context.
Returns the current item’s `DefId` by calling `self.item_def_id.to_def_id()`.
Disables inference during item-signature lowering by always returning `false`.
Rejects inferred regions during item-signature lowering by always returning `None`.
Handles inferred types in item signatures by calling `self.tcx()` and `Ty::new_error_with_message` to produce an error type for a bad placeholder.

Handles inferred consts in item signatures by first calling `self.tcx.fold_regions` to normalize regions in the const’s type, then calling `self.tcx()` and `ty::Const::new_error_with_message` to produce an error constant.
Queries predicates available on a type parameter by calling `self.tcx.at(span).type_param_predicates((self.item_def_id, def_id, assoc_name))`.

Lowers an associated type projection. If the trait reference has no escaping bound vars, it calls `poly_trait_ref.no_bound_vars`, then `self.lowerer().lower_generic_args_of_assoc_item`, and finally `Ty::new_projection`. Otherwise it builds diagnostics/suggestions for uninferred higher-ranked lifetimes, using `self.node()`, `self.hir_id()`, `self.tcx.hir()`, `self.tcx.instantiate_bound_regions_uncached`, and emitting an error via `self.tcx.dcx().emit_err`, before returning an error type.
Attempts to recover the ADT definition for a type by calling `ty.ty_adt_def()`.
No-op hook for recording lowered signature types; it does not call any other methods in this file.
Indicates that item-signature lowering runs without an inference context by always returning `None`.
Stores the provided error in the item context’s tainted-by-errors slot so later lowering can observe that this item already failed. It calls `set` on `self.tainted_by_errors`.

Chooses a fresh lifetime name not already used by the referenced late-bound regions or the HIR generics, first collecting existing names via `collect_referenced_late_bound_regions` and then scanning generated `'a`, `'b`, … candidates until one is unused.

Drives signature-level collection for a top-level HIR item by matching its kind and forcing the relevant queries or validation. For foreign items it ensures `generics_of`, `type_of`, and `predicates_of`, additionally calling `fn_sig`/`codegen_fn_attrs` for foreign functions and `placeholder_type_error` after visiting foreign statics. For enums it ensures `generics_of`, `type_of`, and `predicates_of`, then calls `lower_enum_variant_types`. For impls it ensures `generics_of`, `type_of`, `impl_trait_header`, `predicates_of`, and `associated_items`. For traits it ensures `generics_of`, `trait_def`, `super_predicates_of`, `predicates_of`, and `associated_items`. It similarly triggers the appropriate bound/predicate/type queries for trait aliases, structs, unions, opaque types, and constructors, including calling `lower_variant_ctor` where needed.

Performs collection for a trait item after first ensuring `generics_of`. It ensures `codegen_fn_attrs`, `type_of`, and `fn_sig` for methods; ensures `type_of` and may call `placeholder_type_error` for associated consts; ensures `item_bounds`, `item_super_predicates`, and optionally `type_of` for associated types, also calling `placeholder_type_error` after placeholder visitation. It always finishes by ensuring `predicates_of`.

Performs collection for an impl item by ensuring `generics_of`, `type_of`, and `predicates_of` up front. For impl methods it also ensures `codegen_fn_attrs` and `fn_sig`; for associated types and non-infer associated consts it visits the item for placeholders and calls `placeholder_type_error`.
Forces the basic signature-level queries for a variant constructor by ensuring `generics_of`, `type_of`, and `predicates_of`.

Computes enum variant discriminants, reports overflow, and forces field/constructor collection for every variant. It calls `adt_def` to fetch the enum definition, ensures `generics_of`, `type_of`, and `predicates_of` for each field, and calls `lower_variant_ctor` for each present constructor.

Looks up a named field index within a non-enum ADT, recursively descending through unnamed nested fields. It calls `adt_def` to inspect the ADT, `type_of(...).instantiate_identity()` to inspect unnamed field types, and recursively calls `find_field` through `tcx.find_field` when nested ADTs are encountered.
Builds the nested-field help payload for duplicate-field diagnostics from the stored span.
Converts a plain span into the non-nested `FieldDeclSpan` variant.
Converts a `NestedSpan` into the nested `FieldDeclSpan` variant.
Creates a fresh field-uniqueness checker with the given type context and an empty seen-field map, using `default` for the map.

Checks whether a field name was already seen and emits the appropriate duplicate-field diagnostic depending on whether the current and previous declarations are nested or not. When constructing nested diagnostics it calls `to_field_already_declared_nested_help`; otherwise it records a new field with `insert`.

Recursively traverses all fields of a nested ADT to enforce field-name uniqueness across flattened unnamed fields. For unnamed subfields it inspects `type_of(...).instantiate_identity()` and recursively calls `check_field_in_nested_adt`; for named subfields it calls `check_field_decl`.

Validates one field in a struct/union uniqueness check. Named fields are immediately passed to `check_field_decl`. Anonymous fields recurse into inline anonymous ADTs by calling `check_field` on their members, or into referenced local ADTs by calling `check_field_in_nested_adt`; unexpected field types trigger delayed bugs and abort.

Lowers one HIR variant/struct body into a `ty::VariantDef`, collecting field metadata and tracking whether unnamed fields exist. It creates a `FieldUniquenessCheckContext` with `new` and, for non-anonymous parents, calls `check_field` while iterating fields before constructing the final `VariantDef`.

Builds the compiler’s `ty::AdtDef` for a local enum, struct, union, or anonymous ADT. It inherits repr options from the parent ADT for anonymous fields or uses `repr_options_of_def` otherwise, lowers each enum variant or the single struct/union body by calling `lower_variant`, and finally constructs the ADT with `mk_adt_def`.

Builds a `ty::TraitDef` from a trait or trait alias item, collecting trait flags, validating special attributes, and extracting attribute-driven metadata such as specialization and must-implement-one-of requirements. It does not call other methods from this methods list.

Computes the polymorphic function signature for local functions, methods, foreign functions, constructors, and closures based on their HIR form. It calls `infer_return_ty_for_fn_sig` for functions whose return type may be inferred, `compute_sig_of_foreign_fn_decl` for foreign functions, and for constructor cases uses `type_of` to build the synthesized constructor signature directly.

Handles function signatures with inferred return types by consulting type checking results, diagnosing illegal placeholders, and recovering with a suggested explicit return type when possible. It may call `suggest_impl_trait` to format an `impl Trait` replacement, and falls back to ordinary lowering by calling `lower_fn_ty` through the item lowerer when no inferred return type is present.

Attempts to turn a concrete return type into a printable `impl Trait` suggestion for well-known traits like `Iterator`, `Future`, and the `Fn*` traits by probing trait implementation and formatting associated output types. It does not call other methods from this methods list.

Lowers the trait portion of an `impl` into a `ty::ImplTraitHeader` when the impl is trait-based. It calls `type_of` to obtain the self type, `check_impl_constness` to validate const impls before lowering the trait ref, and `polarity_of_impl` to compute the impl polarity.
Validates that a `const impl` targets a trait marked with `#[const_trait]`, returning an emitted error if not. It does not call other methods from this methods list.
Determines whether an impl is positive, negative, or reservation, while also diagnosing invalid uses of the reservation-impl attribute. It does not call other methods from this methods list.
Returns an iterator over lifetime parameters in the given generics that are early-bound by filtering out late-bound lifetimes with `is_late_bound`.

Combines the item’s explicit predicates with inferred outlives predicates into one `GenericPredicates` result. It calls `explicit_predicates_of` and `inferred_outlives_of`, appending the inferred predicates when present.

Computes the signature of a foreign function declaration, using intrinsic unsafety for Rust intrinsics and otherwise `unsafe`, then lowering the declaration and checking the SIMD-in-FFI feature gate. It calls `intrinsic_operation_unsafety` and lowers the signature with `lower_fn_ty` through a fresh `ItemCtxt`.
Returns the coroutine kind for a local closure expression if the HIR node is a coroutine closure, otherwise `None`.
Given a coroutine-closure shim, locates the inner coroutine closure expression in its body and returns that generated coroutine’s `DefId`.
Checks whether a local opaque type item originated from a type alias `impl Trait` definition by inspecting the opaque type origin.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_ast_lowering/src/lib.rs::: Constructs a fresh `LoweringContext` with initial lowering state, empty owner-local caches, and feature-gated symbol allowlists derived from `tcx.features()`. It calls `SortedMap::default`/`Default::default` to initialize maps, vectors, and flags, and uses `.into()` to build the allowlist sets.
Returns the diagnostic context associated with the current type context by calling `self.tcx.dcx()`.

Looks up legacy const-generic rewrite positions for a path expression naming a non-local function with no explicit generic arguments. It inspects the last path segment via `last`/`unwrap`, checks existing args with `is_some`, reads resolution data from `partial_res_map.get(...).full_res()`, filters out local defs with `is_local`, and returns a cloned stored argument list via `legacy_const_generic_args.get(...).clone()` when present.
Fetches the stored partial resolution for a node id from `partial_res_map` by calling `get` and `copied`.
Returns the per-namespace import resolution for a node id from `import_res_map`, calling `get`, `copied`, and `unwrap_or_default` to supply an empty result when absent.
Fetches the resolved target node id for a label from `label_res_map` by calling `get` and `copied`.
Fetches the resolved lifetime information for a node id from `lifetimes_res_map` by calling `get` and `copied`.
Removes and returns any synthesized extra lifetime parameters associated with a node id from `extra_lifetime_params_map`, calling `remove` and `unwrap_or_default`.
Formats an `ImplTraitPosition` as a user-facing descriptive string by matching the enum variant and writing the chosen text with `write!`.

Builds an index from local def-ids to their owning AST nodes for the crate and nested items. It creates the `Indexer` with `IndexVec::new`, seeds the crate entry via `ensure_contains_elem`, then traverses the AST by calling `visit::walk_crate`, which dispatches into the visitor methods `visit_item`, `visit_assoc_item`, and `visit_foreign_item` while skipping attribute lowering through `visit_attribute`.
Intentionally ignores attributes so expressions inside attributes are not indexed or lowered; it does not call other methods in this file.
Registers an AST item as the owner for its def-id in the index by calling `ensure_contains_elem`, then continues recursive traversal by calling `visit::walk_item`.
Registers an associated item as the owner for its def-id in the index by calling `ensure_contains_elem`, then continues recursive traversal by calling `visit::walk_assoc_item`.
Registers a foreign item as the owner for its def-id in the index by calling `ensure_contains_elem`, then continues recursive traversal by calling `visit::walk_item`.

Computes a stable crate HIR fingerprint by collecting owner entries, pairing each with its `def_path_hash` via `tcx.hir().def_path_hash`, sorting them with `sort_unstable_by_key`, and hashing the result inside `tcx.with_stable_hashing_context` using `StableHasher::new`, `hash_stable`, and `finish`.

Drives AST-to-HIR lowering for the whole crate. It first forces prerequisite queries with `ensure_with_value`, obtains and steals the resolver/AST pair, calls `index_crate` to build the AST owner index, allocates the owner table with `IndexVec::from_fn_n`, lowers each indexed owner by calling `item::ItemLowerer::lower_node`, drops AST data to free memory, and conditionally calls `compute_hir_hash` when `tcx.needs_crate_hash()` is true.

Creates and records a new local definition for an AST node. It first checks for an existing mapping by calling `opt_local_def_id`, uses `local_def_id` and `self.tcx.hir().def_key(...)` in the assertion message if one exists, then creates the def with `self.tcx.at(span).create_def(...).def_id()` and records it with `resolver.node_id_to_def_id.insert(...)`.
Allocates the next fresh AST `NodeId` from the resolver counter by calling `as_u32`, `checked_add`, `expect`, and `ast::NodeId::from_u32`, then updates the stored next id.
Looks up the original local def-id mapped to an AST node in `resolver.node_id_to_def_id` by calling `get` and `copied`.
Returns the possibly remapped local def-id for an AST node by calling `orig_opt_local_def_id` and then `get_remapped_def_id` on the result.
Returns the local def-id for an AST node, calling `opt_local_def_id` and panicking via `unwrap_or_else` if no mapping exists.

Resolves the innermost remapping for a local def-id from the `generics_def_id_map` stack by iterating in reverse and using `find_map`, `get`, and `copied`, falling back with `unwrap_or` to the original id when no remap exists.

Temporarily switches lowering state to a new HIR owner, runs the supplied lowering closure, packages the produced owner data, and restores the previous context. It calls `local_def_id` to resolve the owner, uses `std::mem::take`/`replace` to swap state, inserts the owner's zero local id with `insert`, invokes the closure `f(self)`, calls `make_owner_info` to build the final owner info, and finally records the owner in `children`.

Executes a closure with an additional generic def-id remapping layer active. It pushes the remap onto `generics_def_id_map`, calls the provided closure `f`, then pops the remap before returning the closure result.

Finalizes the accumulated data for one HIR owner into arena-allocated `OwnerInfo`. It takes the pending attrs, bodies, trait map, and inline-const flag, sorts bodies, builds a `SortedMap` with `from_presorted_elements`, calls `self.tcx.hash_owner_nodes(...)` to compute owner and attribute hashes, calls `index::index_hir` to build node and parenting indices, and allocates the resulting `hir::OwnerInfo` with `self.arena.alloc(...)`.

Maps an AST `NodeId` to a HIR id for the current owner, reusing an existing mapping or allocating a new local id. On a vacant entry it inserts the new local id, advances the counter with `increment_by`, calls `opt_local_def_id` to record nested def ownership in `children`, and transfers any pending trait candidates from `resolver.trait_map.remove(...)` into the local `trait_map`.
Allocates the next fresh `HirId` for the current owner by reading the current counter, incrementing it with `increment_by`, and returning the resulting owner/local-id pair.

Converts a resolver `Res<NodeId>` into a HIR `Res` by calling `apply_id` to rewrite each referenced node id through the current `node_id_to_local_id` mapping, using `get` and `copied` for lookup. If rewriting fails for an enclosing-owner local, it returns `Res::Err` via `unwrap_or`.
Obtains the full resolver result for a node id by calling `self.resolver.get_partial_res(id)` and converting it with `map_or(..., |pr| pr.expect_full_res())`, defaulting to `Res::Err` if missing.

Lowers all present import resolutions for a node into HIR results. It calls `self.resolver.get_import_res(id).present_items()`, lowers each entry by calling `lower_res`, and if nothing is resolved it calls `dcx()` and then `span_delayed_bug` before returning `Res::Err`.
Builds a resolved HIR qpath for a lang item. This method explicitly calls `make_lang_item_path` and wraps the result in `hir::QPath::Resolved`.

Constructs and arena-allocates a single-segment HIR path for a lang item by resolving its `DefId`, computing its `Res`, and creating a fresh segment `HirId`. It calls `require_lang_item`, `def_kind`, and `next_id`.
Marks a span as desugared with the given reason and optional unstable allowances using the stable hashing context and current edition. It calls `with_stable_hashing_context` and `mark_with_reason`.
Adjusts a span for HIR lowering, attaching the current owner as the parent only when incremental compilation is enabled; otherwise returns the span unchanged.
Rebuilds an identifier with its span lowered for HIR. This method explicitly calls `lower_span`.

Converts a resolved lifetime into a HIR lifetime generic parameter, creating a new lifetime definition for fresh elided lifetimes and skipping `static`/error cases. It calls `create_def`, `lower_node_id`, `local_def_id`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers explicit binder generic parameters, appends resolver-provided extra lifetime parameters, and arena-allocates the combined HIR parameter list. It calls `lower_generic_params_mut`, `take_extra_lifetime_params`, and `lifetime_res_to_generic_param`.
Temporarily overrides the `is_in_dyn_type` flag while executing a closure, then restores the previous state.
Executes a closure in a fresh lowering scope by temporarily replacing current item, loop-condition, catch, and loop scope state, then restoring all previous values afterward.
Lowers and stores attributes for a HIR node, returning `None` for an empty attribute list. This method explicitly calls `lower_attr` for each attribute.
Lowers a single AST attribute by preserving its path/data structure, stripping tokens, lowering its arguments, and lowering its span. It calls `lower_attr_args` and `lower_span`.
Aliases already-lowered attributes from one HIR local id to another within the same owner when the target has stored attributes.

Lowers attribute arguments, recursively lowering delimited arguments and converting inert key-value literal expressions into HIR literal form, synthesizing an error literal when parsing fails. It calls `lower_delim_args` and `dcx`.
Lowers delimited attribute arguments by preserving delimiter/span data and flattening the token stream.

Lowers an associated type constraint, including its generic arguments, equality/const/type terms, and bound forms, while diagnosing invalid parenthesized or return-type-notation syntax. This method explicitly calls `lower_angle_bracketed_parameter_data`, `emit_bad_parenthesized_trait_in_assoc_ty`, `dcx`, `lower_ty`, `lower_anon_const`, `lower_param_bounds`, `lower_node_id`, and `lower_ident`.
Emits a diagnostic for illegal parenthesized associated type syntax, computing a targeted suggestion for either removing empty parentheses or replacing them with angle brackets. It calls `dcx`.

Lowers a generic argument as a lifetime, type, inferred arg, or const arg, including the path-type-to-const disambiguation path used for trivial const arguments. It calls `lower_lifetime`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_span`, `get_partial_res`, `next_node_id`, `create_def`, `with_new_scopes`, `lower_const_body`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_anon_const`.
Lowers an AST type and arena-allocates the resulting HIR type node. This method explicitly calls `lower_ty_direct`.

Lowers a path type, opportunistically converting a bare resolved trait path into a trait object when needed for fresh anonymous lifetimes; otherwise lowers it as a normal qpath type. It calls `get_partial_res`, `with_dyn_type_scope`, `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `elided_dyn_bound`, `lower_span`, `next_id`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_qpath`, and `ty_path`.
Constructs a HIR type node with a fresh `HirId` and lowered span. It calls `next_id` and `lower_span`.
Constructs a tuple HIR type from pre-lowered element types. This method explicitly calls `ty`.

Performs the main AST-to-HIR lowering for type syntax, handling anonymous ADTs, pointers/references, functions, tuples, paths, and other type forms while creating nested owners when required. This method explicitly calls `local_def_id`, `with_hir_id_owner`, `lower_field_def`, `lower_span`, `lower_ty`, `lower_mt`, `get_lifetime_res`, `next_node_id`, `lower_lifetime`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_safety`, `lower_extern`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_fn_params_to_names`.

Lowers an `impl Trait` opaque type by marking its desugared span, determining which lifetimes must be captured or duplicated based on origin and precise captures, and delegating final opaque construction. It calls `mark_span_with_reason`, `take_extra_lifetime_params`, `lower_opaque_inner`, and `lower_param_bounds`.

Builds the internal HIR representation for an opaque type: creates the opaque definition, synthesizes duplicated lifetime parameters and mappings, lowers bounds under the remapping, lowers precise captures when present, and emits the owning `OpaqueTy` item plus returned `OpaqueDef` type. It calls `create_def`, `get_lifetime_res`, `dcx`, `next_node_id`, `lower_span`, `lower_ident`, `new_named_lifetime_with_res`, `local_def_id`, `with_hir_id_owner`, `with_remapping`, `lower_item_bounds`, `lower_precise_capturing_args`, and `lower_node_id`.

Extracts lowered parameter names from a function declaration, using the lowered identifier for simple identifier patterns and an empty placeholder ident otherwise. It calls `lower_ident` and `lower_span`.

Lowers a function signature by dropping the AST varargs sentinel, lowering each input type under the appropriate `impl Trait` policy, and lowering the return type either normally or through coroutine-specific opaque-return handling. It calls `lower_ty_direct`, `local_def_id`, `lower_coroutine_fn_ret_ty`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers the return type of async/generator-style functions by creating the desugared opaque return type, collecting captured lifetimes, lowering the coroutine output bound, and returning it as a HIR function return type. It calls `lower_span`, `mark_span_with_reason`, `take_extra_lifetime_params`, `lower_opaque_inner`, `lower_coroutine_fn_output_type_to_bound`, `ty`, and `alloc`.

Builds the trait bound placed on a coroutine’s synthesized opaque return type by lowering the explicit/default output type and binding it to the appropriate lang-item associated type (`Future::Output`, `Iterator::Item`, or `AsyncIterator::Item`). It calls `lower_ty`, `ty_tup`, `assoc_ty_binding`, `make_lang_item_path`, and `next_id`.

Lowers a single generic bound into HIR, converting trait bounds and outlives bounds through the appropriate lowerers. It calls `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `lower_trait_bound_modifiers`, and `lower_lifetime`.
Lowers an AST lifetime by first calling `lower_ident` on the lifetime name, then calling `new_named_lifetime` with the original node id to build the HIR lifetime.

Constructs and arena-allocates a HIR lifetime from an explicit `LifetimeRes`, remapping parameter def-ids when needed via `get_remapped_def_id` or `local_def_id`, and filling the HIR node with `lower_node_id` and `lower_ident`.
Resolves a lifetime through `get_lifetime_res`, defaulting to `LifetimeRes::Error` on failure, then calls `new_named_lifetime_with_res` to produce the lowered HIR lifetime.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic parameter by mapping the input slice and calling `lower_generic_param` for every element.
Lowers a slice of generic parameters into arena-allocated HIR output by calling `lower_generic_params_mut` and collecting the iterator with `alloc_from_iter`.

Lowers one generic parameter by calling `lower_generic_param_kind` to compute its HIR name and kind, then assigns ids/spans/attributes using `lower_node_id`, `lower_attrs`, `local_def_id`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers the kind-specific portion of a generic parameter. For lifetime params it queries `get_lifetime_res` and may call `lower_ident`; for type params it may emit diagnostics through `dcx` and lowers defaults with `lower_ty`; for const params it lowers the type with `lower_ty` and lowers any default const expression with `lower_anon_const`.
Lowers an AST trait reference by calling `lower_qpath`, requiring the result to be a resolved trait path, and then creating the HIR trait ref with `lower_node_id` for the reference id.
Lowers a poly trait reference by calling `lower_lifetime_binder` for bound generic params, `lower_trait_ref` for the trait itself, and `lower_span` for the resulting HIR span.
Lowers a mutable type by calling `lower_ty` on the inner type and preserving the mutability flag.
Lowers a slice of generic bounds into arena-allocated HIR bounds by calling `lower_param_bounds_mut` and collecting with `alloc_from_iter`.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic bound by mapping the slice and calling `lower_param_bound` on each element.

Synthesizes a universal type parameter, its optional where-predicate, and the corresponding type path. It uses `local_def_id`, `lower_span`, `lower_node_id`, and `lower_ident` to build the parameter, calls `lower_generic_bound_predicate` to lower the bounds, and uses `next_id` plus arena allocation to construct the `TyKind::Path`.
Lowers an AST block expression by calling `lower_block` and then wrapping the result with `expr_block`.

Lowers an array length const expression. For `_`, it may create an inferred length using `lower_node_id` and `lower_span` when the feature is enabled; otherwise it reports instability and falls back to calling `lower_anon_const`. All non-underscore lengths are lowered by calling `lower_anon_const`.

Lowers an anonymous const inside fresh scopes by calling `with_new_scopes`; within that closure it uses `local_def_id`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_const_body`, and `lower_span`, then arena-allocates the resulting HIR anon const.
Maps the AST `UnsafeSource` enum directly to the corresponding HIR `UnsafeSource` variant without calling other methods from the list.

Converts AST trait-bound constness/polarity modifiers into the corresponding HIR trait-bound modifier, consulting the `negative_bounds` feature gate for negative bounds and otherwise performing a direct variant mapping.
Builds a HIR statement by assigning a fresh id with `next_id` and lowering the statement span with `lower_span`.
Builds an expression statement by arena-allocating the expression and then calling `stmt` with `hir::StmtKind::Expr`.

Builds a `let` statement from a pre-lowered pattern and optional initializer. It assigns a fresh id with `next_id`, lowers the span with `lower_span`, stores statement attributes when present, and finally calls `stmt` after arena-allocating the `hir::LetStmt`.
Wraps a lowered expression in a block by calling `block_all` with no statements and the expression as the tail expression.
Constructs and arena-allocates a HIR block from statements and an optional tail expression, assigning a fresh block id with `next_id` and lowering the span with `lower_span`.
Builds a `ControlFlow::Continue` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the payload and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::ControlFlowContinue`.
Builds a `ControlFlow::Break` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the payload and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::ControlFlowBreak`.
Builds an `Option::Some` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the contained pattern and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::OptionSome`.
Builds an `Option::None` pattern by directly calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::OptionNone` and no fields.
Creates a single tuple-struct-style pattern field for index 0, assigning a fresh field id with `next_id` and lowering the field spans with `lower_span`.
Builds a struct pattern referring to a lang item variant by lowering the span with `lower_span` to form a `QPath::LangItem`, then calling `pat` with `hir::PatKind::Struct`.
Builds an identifier pattern with the default binding mode by calling `pat_ident_binding_mode` with `hir::BindingMode::NONE`.

Convenience wrapper that creates a mutable identifier pattern using no explicit binding mode. It calls `pat_ident_binding_mode_mut` with `hir::BindingMode::NONE` and returns the resulting pattern and `HirId`.

Builds an identifier pattern with an explicit binding mode, then allocates it in the HIR arena. It calls `pat_ident_binding_mode_mut` to construct the `hir::Pat` and `self.arena.alloc` to return a shared HIR reference together with its `HirId`.

Constructs an owned `hir::Pat` for an identifier binding with the given binding mode. It calls `next_id` to assign a fresh `HirId`, `lower_ident` to lower the identifier, and `lower_span` to lower the source span.

Allocates a general HIR pattern with default binding modes enabled. It calls `next_id` to create the pattern’s `HirId`, `lower_span` to lower the span, and `self.arena.alloc` to store the pattern in the arena.
Constructs an owned HIR pattern like `pat`, but with `default_binding_modes` disabled. It calls `next_id` for a fresh `HirId` and `lower_span` for the lowered span.

Builds a `hir::Ty` from a qualified path, rewriting resolved trait or trait-alias paths into `hir::TyKind::TraitObject`. In that trait-object case it calls `lower_span` to build the `PolyTraitRef`, `next_id` to give the outer `Ty` a new id, and `elided_dyn_bound` to supply the implicit `dyn` lifetime bound; it also calls `lower_span` again for the final type span.

Creates and arena-allocates an implicit object lifetime bound used for elided `dyn` lifetimes. It calls `next_id` to assign a `HirId`, `lower_span` to lower the span used in the lifetime identifier, and `self.arena.alloc` to return the allocated lifetime.

If the `effects` feature is enabled, lowers a bound constness marker into a synthetic const generic argument and appends it to the argument list. For `Always` and `Maybe` it calls `lcx.lower_span` to lower spans; in the `Maybe` case it may call `lcx.dcx().span_delayed_bug` when `host_param_id` is missing, otherwise it calls `lcx.next_id` to build the host path. After selecting the expression body, it calls `lcx.lower_body` and inside that closure `lcx.expr` to lower the const expression, then calls `lcx.next_node_id`, `lcx.next_id`, and `lcx.create_def` to create the anonymous const, and finally pushes the resulting const argument into `self.args`.
Checks whether the generic-argument builder contains no args, no bindings, and no parenthesized form. It does not call any other methods from the provided list.

Finalizes the builder into an arena-allocated `hir::GenericArgs`. It calls `this.arena.alloc_from_iter` to allocate the argument list, `this.lower_span` to lower the stored span, and `this.arena.alloc` to allocate the completed `hir::GenericArgs`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_ast_lowering/src/item.rs:: Selects the preferred parsed type-alias `where` clause location and copies its `has_where_token` flag and span into `generics.where_clause`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Creates and initializes a fresh `LoweringContext` for one HIR owner, runs the supplied lowering closure inside `with_hir_id_owner`, and then publishes collected child-owner info back into `self.owners`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Entry point for lowering a `LocalDefId`: ensures an owner slot exists, skips already-lowered owners, dispatches by `AstOwner` kind, and returns the cached/lowered owner. It explicitly calls `lower_crate`, `lower_item`, `lower_assoc_item`, and `lower_foreign_item` depending on the AST owner kind.

Lowers the crate root as the crate HIR owner by creating a lowering context with `with_lctx`, lowering the top-level module, lowering crate attributes, and allocating a `hir::OwnerNode::Crate`. It explicitly calls `with_lctx` and, inside the closure, `lower_mod`.

Lowers one AST item as its own HIR owner by invoking `with_lctx` and wrapping the lowered result as `hir::OwnerNode::Item`. It explicitly calls `with_lctx` and, inside the closure, `LoweringContext::lower_item`.

Lowers an associated item after first lowering its parent owner so parent HIR context is available, sets `is_in_trait_impl` when the parent is a trait impl, and then lowers the item as either a trait item or impl item. It explicitly calls `lower_node`, `with_lctx`, and then either `lower_trait_item` or `lower_impl_item`.

Lowers a foreign item as its own HIR owner via `with_lctx` and wraps it as `hir::OwnerNode::ForeignItem`. It explicitly calls `with_lctx` and, inside the closure, `LoweringContext::lower_foreign_item`.
Builds a HIR module by lowering module spans and collecting all contained item ids into arena storage. It explicitly calls `lower_item_ref` for each item.

Produces the HIR `ItemId` list referenced by an AST item, starting with the item's own id and expanding `use` items to include desugared imports. It explicitly calls `lower_item_id_use_tree` for `ItemKind::Use`.

Recursively flattens a `use` tree into all generated `hir::ItemId`s, descending into nested imports and adding extra ids for multi-namespace simple imports. It explicitly calls itself recursively via `lower_item_id_use_tree`.
Constructs a full HIR item by lowering spans, owner id, attributes, item kind, and identifier, then allocating the result. It explicitly calls `lower_item_kind`.

Dispatches lowering for each AST `ItemKind` into the corresponding HIR form, including imports, const/statics, functions, modules, foreign modules, global asm, type aliases, enums, and structs. It explicitly calls `lower_use_tree`, `lower_const_item`, `lower_maybe_async_body`, `lower_fn_decl`, `lower_mod`, `lower_foreign_item_ref`, `lower_inline_asm`, `add_ty_alias_where_clause`, `lower_generics`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_variant` in the relevant match arms.
Lowers a const-like item's declared type and body expression, returning the HIR type plus body id. It explicitly calls `lower_const_body`.

Lowers a `use` tree into HIR import form, handling prefix concatenation, `self` imports, multi-namespace desugaring, nested imports, and creation of extra synthetic child owners for split imports. It explicitly calls itself recursively via `lower_use_tree` when lowering nested imports.

Lowers an associated AST item into either a HIR trait item or impl item after deriving the effective constness from the parent trait/impl owner. It inspects the parent with `node` and `expect_item`, and for trait items calls `lower_trait_item`; for impl items it calls `lower_impl_item`.

Constructs a HIR foreign item by lowering its owner id, attributes, identifier, kind, and spans, with special handling for extern functions, statics, and type aliases. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Builds a lightweight `hir::ForeignItemRef` containing the lowered id, identifier, and span for a foreign item reference. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Lowers one enum variant by lowering its id, attributes, field data, optional discriminant, identifier, and span. It explicitly calls `lower_variant_data`.

Lowers struct-, tuple-, or unit-style variant payloads, creating field definitions and aliasing constructor attributes to the parent where needed. It explicitly calls `lower_field_def` for each field.

Lowers a struct or tuple field definition, choosing path-specific or general type lowering, then lowering field id, attributes, spans, and identifier. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers a trait associated item into HIR, handling consts, required/provided methods, and type aliases with merged type-alias `where` clauses, plus final attributes and spans. It explicitly calls `add_ty_alias_where_clause` when lowering associated type aliases.
Builds a lightweight `hir::TraitItemRef` describing a trait associated item’s id, kind, defaultness, identifier, and span. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Builds a HIR error expression for the given span and guaranteed error by calling `expr` with `hir::ExprKind::Err`.

Lowers an impl associated item into HIR, handling consts, methods, and type aliases, including merged type-alias `where` clauses and trait-vs-inherent method context. It explicitly calls `add_ty_alias_where_clause` when lowering associated type aliases.

Builds a lightweight `hir::ImplItemRef` containing the impl item’s id, identifier, span, defaultness, kind, and optional linked trait-item def id. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Converts AST defaultness into HIR defaultness, preserving the lowered `default` span when present and asserting finals always have a value. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Creates a HIR body from parameters and an expression, verifies it belongs to the current owner, stores it in the owner body table, and returns its `BodyId`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Runs a closure to lower a body while temporarily saving and restoring generator/task-context state, then records the resulting HIR body. It explicitly calls `record_body`.
Lowers a function parameter by lowering its id, attributes, pattern, and type/span information into `hir::Param`. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.
Lowers a function body by first lowering all input parameters and then lowering the body expression inside the generic body-lowering wrapper. It explicitly calls `lower_body` and `lower_param`.
Convenience wrapper for lowering a function body stored as an optional block expression. It explicitly calls `lower_fn_body` and `lower_block_expr_opt`.
Lowers an optional block into an expression, or produces an error expression when the block is missing. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Lowers an optional const expression into a HIR body. It calls `lower_body` to create the body, and inside that closure calls `lower_expr_mut` for a present expression or `expr_err` to synthesize an error expression when the const body is missing.

Lowers a function body, using the normal path when the function is not a coroutine and the coroutine desugaring path otherwise. In the non-coroutine case it calls `lower_fn_body_block`; in the coroutine case it calls `lower_body`, whose closure calls `lower_coroutine_body_with_moved_arguments`, `lower_block_expr`, `lower_node_id`, and `maybe_forward_track_caller`.

Desugars coroutine/async function parameters into moved captures plus local `let` bindings, then wraps the lowered body in the coroutine expression structure needed for correct capture and drop order. It calls `lower_param` for each input, uses helpers such as `pat_ident`, `expr_ident`, `stmt_let_pat`, `pat_ident_binding_mode`, `expr_drop_temps`, `block_all`, `expr_block`, and `lower_body`, allocates HIR nodes with `alloc`/`alloc_from_iter`, and finally creates the coroutine with `make_desugared_coroutine_expr` after obtaining the closure HIR id via `lower_node_id`.

Lowers a method signature by translating the header, injecting implicit generics, and lowering the function declaration. It calls `lower_fn_header`, `add_implicit_generics`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_span`.
Lowers an AST `FnHeader` into its HIR form by translating each header flag. It calls `lower_unsafety`, `lower_asyncness`, `lower_constness`, and `lower_extern`.
Resolves a parsed ABI string into a concrete `abi::Abi`. If lookup fails, it calls `error_on_invalid_abi` and falls back to `abi::Abi::Rust`.
Lowers an `Extern` specifier into the effective ABI. For explicit extern declarations, it calls `lower_abi`; otherwise it returns the default Rust or fallback ABI directly.
Emits the diagnostic for an invalid ABI literal, labeling the ABI span and listing valid ABI names. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.

Converts AST constness into HIR constness by mapping `Const::Yes` to `hir::Constness::Const` and `Const::No` to `hir::Constness::NotConst`. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Converts AST unsafety into HIR unsafety by mapping `Unsafe::Yes` to `hir::Unsafety::Unsafe` and `Unsafe::No` to `hir::Unsafety::Normal`. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Lowers generics fully into `hir::Generics` by first building the intermediate representation and then materializing arena-backed storage. It calls `lower_generics_mut` and `into_generics`.

Builds a HIR where-predicate for a generic parameter’s bounds, skipping empty bounds and reconstructing an appropriate predicate span. It first calls `lower_param_bounds` and `lower_ident`; for type parameters it then calls `local_def_id`, `next_id`, `alloc`, `alloc_from_iter`, and `ty_path`, while for lifetime parameters it calls `lower_ident`, `next_node_id`, and `new_named_lifetime`.

Lowers one AST where-predicate into its HIR variant. Depending on the predicate kind, it calls `lower_generic_params`, `lower_ty`, `lower_param_bound`, and `lower_span` for bound predicates; `lower_span`, `lower_lifetime`, and `lower_param_bounds` for region predicates; and `lower_node_id`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_span` for equality predicates.

It calls `has_late_bound_regions` to detect whether the resulting generics should record late-bound regions.

Helper for function-like signatures that first checks generic lifetime parameters for `tcx.is_late_bound`, then traverses the function declaration with `LateBoundRegionsDetector` and returns any recorded span. It calls `impl<'tcx> Visitor<'tcx> for LateBoundRegionsDetector<'tcx>::visit_ty@445-457`, `impl<'tcx> Visitor<'tcx> for LateBoundRegionsDetector<'tcx>::visit_poly_trait_ref@459-466`, and `impl<'tcx> Visitor<'tcx> for LateBoundRegionsDetector<'tcx>::visit_lifetime@468-486` indirectly via `visitor.visit_fn_decl(decl)`.

Visits a type while searching for late-bound regions, adjusting the Debruijn depth when entering bare function types and otherwise recursively traversing the type. It calls `impl<'tcx> Visitor<'tcx> for LateBoundRegionsDetector<'tcx>::visit_ty@445-457` recursively through `intravisit::walk_ty`.

Visits a poly trait reference while searching for late-bound regions, increasing the Debruijn depth for the binder and then recursively walking the trait reference. It calls `impl<'tcx> Visitor<'tcx> for LateBoundRegionsDetector<'tcx>::visit_poly_trait_ref@459-466` recursively through `intravisit::walk_poly_trait_ref`.

Examines a lifetime occurrence and marks an error span when it resolves to an unexpected late-bound, free, erroneous, or unresolved lifetime outside the currently permitted binder depth. It does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Helper for function-like signatures that first checks generic lifetime parameters for `tcx.is_late_bound`, then traverses the function declaration with `LateBoundRegionsDetector` and returns any recorded span. It calls `impl<'tcx> Visitor<'tcx> for LateBoundRegionsDetector<'tcx>::visit_ty@445-457`, `impl<'tcx> Visitor<'tcx> for LateBoundRegionsDetector<'tcx>::visit_poly_trait_ref@459-466`, and `impl<'tcx> Visitor<'tcx> for LateBoundRegionsDetector<'tcx>::visit_lifetime@468-486` indirectly via `visitor.visit_fn_decl(decl)`.

Visits a generic parameter and, for const parameters, temporarily marks that traversal is inside a parameter type before visiting the const parameter's type. It may call methods of the visitor during `visit_ty`, but does not directly call another listed method.

Detects whether the target anonymous const occurs inside a const parameter type and otherwise keeps traversing nested anonymous const structure. It calls `impl<'v> Visitor<'v> for AnonConstInParamTyDetector::visit_anon_const@531-537` recursively through `intravisit::walk_anon_const`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/outlives: Drives the fixed-point inference pass over HIR items, collecting implicit outlives requirements for structs, enums, unions, and lazy type aliases and updating the global inferred map until no new predicates are found. It calls `insert_required_predicates_to_be_wf` for each relevant field type or aliased type to compute the local well-formedness requirements.

Walks a type and adds the outlives predicates needed for that type to be well formed. For references it directly records `T: 'a` via `insert_outlives_predicate`; for ADTs and weak aliases it calls both `check_inferred_predicates` and `check_explicit_predicates`; for dyn trait and projection-style alias cases it uses `check_explicit_predicates` with appropriate `Self` filtering to avoid propagating invalid object-self bounds.

Loads the explicit outlives predicates declared on a referenced item, instantiates them with the supplied generic arguments, filters out predicates that mention the ignored `Self` type for `dyn Trait` handling, and adds the surviving requirements to the result. It calls `insert_outlives_predicate` for each instantiated explicit predicate that should be propagated.

Looks up already-inferred predicates for a referenced definition in the global map, instantiates them with the current generic arguments, and adds the resulting requirements to the current item. It calls `insert_outlives_predicate` for each instantiated inferred predicate.
